scenes.text: This is NTSOne, from NTS Digital Solutions. One platform for registrations, voting, orders, payments and bookkeeping.

scenes.card: Too many tools. Too much paperwork.
scenes.text: Running events, elections, orders and money across paper forms, spreadsheets and notebooks is slow, and mistakes are easy to make.

scenes.card: One private workspace for your organization
scenes.text: NTSOne gives your organization one private workspace, with a dashboard that shows everything at a glance.
Build registration forms with drag and drop, share a link or a QR code, and issue ID cards and tickets that can be checked at the door.
Run secret-ballot elections, with optional paid votes and live results that update as people vote.
Give your business an online order page, and create invoices, receipts, quotations and business cards in minutes.

scenes.card: Mobile money payments and a payment fund
scenes.text: Accept Orange Money, Africell Money and QMoney, and follow every payment, refund and withdrawal in your payment fund.
Keep simple books, track monthly contributions, and manage wish lists, all in the same place.
